sayLines.text: 💛 You hold Reading Glasses. You read the fine print on medicine bottles for Gabriel next door, because their hands shook. Dosages, warnings, the tiny words that matter. The apocalypse has fine print too. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Cliffhanger is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
FEASTED ×2.03: the feast was the weapon.

💛 You hold Spare Socks. The flood year, three days in wet boots. Your feet went white and strange. The medic packed them with yarrow and told you: dry socks are civilization. Never again, you said. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.
